primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: The Tarshish article treats the biblical term primarily as an uncertain place-name and briefly notes a man son of Bilhan in a general “Other usage” list; its article does not establish that this Benjamite genealogy figure is the same person. No person-specific matching entry was found.
